content:
The Target store on Del Mar Boulevard in Laredo was evacuated on Saturday afternoon, November 7, after reports of a burning smell inside the store.

Customers and employees were evacuated as a precaution. The source of the smell had not been confirmed as of Saturday afternoon, and no injuries had been reported.

Shoppers should avoid the area while crews check the building. Webb Watch 956 will update this story if Target, police, or fire officials release more information.

Source: Hammrod News, November 7, 2026. No official statement from the Laredo Police Department or Laredo Fire Department had been released as of publication.

title: Target on Del Mar evacuated after reports of burning smell
